rejected.32-bit-rns: The selected nominal 59-bit composite-rescale profile fails the small-circuit numerical gate; its 64-bit control and separate upstream 40-bit 32-bit control pass. No lower model precision is substituted.

reason: Both qualified options reduce operations and pass isolated, prefix and full-model gates. limits: Two full samples per mode on one fixed prompt/checkpoint.
